description:
**About Providence**
--------------------


Providence, one of the US’s largest not\-for\-profit healthcare systems, is committed to high quality, compassionate healthcare for all. Driven by the belief that health is a human right and the vision, ‘Health for a better world’, Providence and its 121,000 caregivers strive to provide everyone access to affordable quality care and services.


Providence has a network of 51 hospitals, 1,000\+ care clinics, senior services, supportive housing, and other health and educational services in the US.


Providence India is bringing to fruition the transformational shift of the healthcare ecosystem to Health 2\.0\. The India center will have focused efforts around healthcare technology and innovation, and play a vital role in driving digital transformation of health systems for improved patient outcomes and experiences, caregiver efficiency, and running the business of Providence at scale.

  

**Why Us?**
-----------

* Best In\-class Benefits
* Inclusive Leadership
* Reimagining Healthcare
* Competitive Pay
* Supportive Reporting Relation

The Principal PM for Healthcare Intelligence will oversee the ideation, planning and execution of the Providence Healthcare Intelligence products and services, leveraging best\-in class technology and systems; includes cloud computing, big data, mobile, data science, and modern software development methodologies and frameworks.

* Conducting research for building hypothesis\-driven smart data products
* Conduct US healthcare market assessments and user/customer interviews
* Frame most valuable healthcare problems that can be addressed with analytics solutions
* Productize analytics solutions
* Feature prioritization and road map planning
* Running design sprints \& and user testing
* Translating business\-to\-technical requirements, and vice versa
* Defining and tracking success metrics
* Mentoring product managers and product owners
  

  

**Detailed Responsibilities**  

  

* Providing product management and business systems analysis for transformational initiatives, capability enhancements, and partnership.
* Drive the health care intelligence product innovation agenda, working closely with product development and other allied teams.
* Envision products, create product roadmaps and ensure successful product increment launches by working with diverse stakeholders
* Provide regular updates to leadership, escalating items when needed but with presence and relationships to identify and resolve most issues independently
* Knowledgeably and successfully present our strategy, roadmap and current progress /actions to senior executive audiences inside the company

* The position is based in Hyderabad and requires flexible work shift schedule to accommodate North American meetings.
  

**Who we’re looking for:**  

* **The ideal candidate should have 10\+ years of product design and engineering experience, with 6\+ years of product management experience especially in curating** **data products****.**
* **Deep knowledge of US healthcare system, care delivery models, compliance aspects**
* Deep experience working with technology products planning and implementation for problem scenarios in healthcare and life science domain is a critical capability.
* Ability to operate in a startup mode, structure ambiguous, open\-ended problems \& analyzing data to discover user needs, most valuable use cases and curating product related insights.
* Ability to own the long\-term vision, strategy, and roadmap for the product, and be able to work autonomously
* Capability to translate problem, data \& user research into developing innovative features \& solutions.
* Ability to work nimbly across multiple projects, with fast\-paced iterative product development cycles.
* Impressive verbal communication and presentation skills and at ease with business as well as technical audiences.
* Ability to tune written communication for clear and concise product related documentation as well as for general business communications.
  

**Desired Skills/Experience**  

  

* Experience in healthcare management and life sciences domain.
* Experience in Data Competency\-data collection, extraction and analytics.
* Certifications in Product Management/Agile/Scrum.
* Familiarity with EHR Modules and cloud product development
* Experience in User research, UX Prototyping would be considered a bonus.
* Working knowledge of statistical and ML modelling would be considered a bonus.
* Knowledge of healthcare delivery models in non\-US markets will be considered a bonus
  

**Primary Skills**  

Healthcare Business Intelligence, Cloud, API and Data Product Incubation and Management, Product Roadmap Development, Requirements Elicitation, User Research, Analysis and Journey Mapping, Business Case Development, Stakeholder Management, UI/UX Prototyping, Data Analysis and Visualization, Technical Writing \& Data Story Telling

Statistical \& ML Model building with, R, SQL, ADO, Visio/Figma, EHR/EMR Modules

**Job Overview:**


LPL Financial is seeking a Data Product Analyst to support our Strategic Data Platforms, with a strong focus on how data is produced, shaped, governed, and delivered to downstream consumers across the firm.


This role sits at the intersection of Product Management, Data Product Ownership, and Advanced Analysis, and is designed for a senior individual contributor who can bring rigor and clarity to complex, data‑centric platform initiatives.


The Data Product Analyst focuses on data as a product—helping define data contracts, validate quality, assess downstream impact, and support data product and platform decisions.


The ideal candidate is comfortable working across upstream systems of record, platform services, and downstream consumers, and excels at turning complex data flows into actionable insights and decisions.

**Responsibilities:**


Product Discovery \& Capability Support

* Support product discovery by helping translate business and platform needs into clear data‑centric problem statements.
* Contribute to roadmap planning by evaluating value, risk, and complexity across data initiatives.
* Help define outcomes and success measures for data platform capabilities (e.g., usability, reliability, adoption, quality).

Advanced Data Analysis \& Problem Solving

* Perform hands‑on exploratory and diagnostic analysis across distributed data sources and platforms.
* Investigate data quality issues, lineage gaps, and semantic inconsistencies that affect downstream consumers.
* Conduct impact analysis for schema changes, new feeds, platform migrations, or system decommissions.
* Identify systemic issues in data flow, transformation, or consumption and recommend durable solutions.

Data Product Ownership (Supporting / Platform‑Level)

* Support Data Product Owners by helping define:
* Data contracts, schemas, and semantic definitions
* Data quality rules, validation logic, and controls
* Usage expectations and downstream dependencies
* Maintain traceability between business intent, data products, and technical implementation.
* Partner with engineering, architecture, and data platform teams to support scalable, reusable distribution patterns.

Agile Execution \& Delivery

* Contribute to Jira artifacts (features, stories, acceptance criteria) with strong data and platform context.
* Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, and demos to ensure work reflects validated platform and consumer needs.
* Support prioritization decisions by providing evidence‑based impact and dependency analysis.

Stakeholder Communication \& Influence

* Act as an analytical partner to Product Managers, Platform Owners, Engineering, and downstream consumer teams.
* Communicate complex data flow and platform concepts in clear, decision‑ready narratives.
* Help align stakeholders across domains by grounding conversations in data realities and trade‑offs.
**What are we looking for?**


We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work.

**Requirements:**

* 5\+ years of experience in Product Analytics, Data Analysis, Data Product Ownership, or Platform‑oriented Product roles.
* Strong hands‑on experience with SQL (advanced querying, joins, performance awareness)
* Experience working with data platforms, distributed data systems, or integration layers.
* Experience adopting emerging AI‑enabled capabilities to improve the speed, depth, and effectiveness of data analysis
* Experience operating in Agile/Scrum environments with cross‑functional product and engineering teams.
* Proven ability to work across ambiguity and translate complex data ecosystems into actionable insights.
* Solid understanding of:
* Data modeling and semantic consistency
* Data quality, lineage, and governance concepts
* Pipelines, and event‑driven architectures (conceptual and analytical understanding)

**Preferences****:**

* Data platform decisions are made with **clear understanding of downstream impact and value**.
* Platform teams have strong analytical support when defining and evolving shared data capabilities.
* Data quality and semantic issues are identified early, before they impact consumers.
**Core Competencies****:**

* Experience supporting advisor data platforms, or shared enterprise data services.
* Familiarity with downstream consumer needs (applications, analytics platforms, partners, regulatory consumers).
* Experience performing impact analysis for data changes across multiple consuming systems.
* Background in financial services, wealth management, or other highly regulated data environments.

 **Job Title:**

 **HIH \- Software Engineering Advisor – SAP Procure\-to\-Pay (PTP) Technical Product Owner**

 **Position Overview**

  

The SAP Procure\-to\-Pay Technical Product Owner is accountable for the vision, strategy, roadmap, backlog, and measurable value of SAP S/4HANA Procure\-to\-Pay capabilities. This role connects procurement and finance stakeholders with architecture, engineering, integration, data, security, and support teams to deliver scalable, compliant, and user\-centered solutions.

  

**Job Overview:**


The Product Owner translates business outcomes into prioritized epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release plans; makes timely scope and priority decisions; and ensures solutions align with enterprise architecture, Clean Core principles, global process standards, and the broader SAP transformation roadmap. The role retains sufficient functional and technical depth to guide solution design across SAP MM/PTP, EDI/IDoc, EWM, Finance\-to\-Manage, Order\-to\-Cash, Learn\-to\-Order, master data, SAP Fiori, BTP, and external supplier platforms.

 **Responsibilities:**

 **Product Strategy, Roadmap \& Agile Delivery**

  

* Define and communicate the product vision, goals, roadmap, and outcome\-based priorities for SAP S/4HANA PTP capabilities.
* Own and continuously refine the product backlog, including epics, features, user stories, technical enablers, defects, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and nonfunctional requirements.
* Prioritize work using business value, user impact, risk reduction, regulatory needs, architectural dependencies, operational stability, cost, and delivery capacity.
* Partner with business leaders, product management, architects, engineering teams, Scrum Masters, and delivery partners to establish release objectives and executable plans.
* Lead discovery, requirements workshops, process reviews, solution option analysis, and decomposition of business needs into implementation\-ready backlog items.
* Participate actively in backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily collaboration, sprint reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and program increment activities as applicable.
* Provide clear and timely decisions on scope, sequencing, tradeoffs, and acceptance; validate completed work against agreed acceptance criteria and product outcomes.
* Maintain stakeholder alignment through transparent roadmap, backlog, dependency, risk, release, and value\-delivery reporting.

 **SAP Solution \& Technical Ownership**

  

* Guide end\-to\-end solution design across purchase requisitions, purchase orders, sourcing, contracts, service procurement, inventory movements, Logistics Invoice Verification, three\-way matching, GR/IR, account determination, and supplier master data.
* Ensure product decisions align with SAP S/4HANA standards, enterprise architecture, Clean Core principles, reusable integration patterns, security, audit controls, and supportability expectations.
* Partner with solution and technical architects to evaluate configuration, extension, integration, workflow, reporting, data, automation, and custom\-development options.
* Own functional intent and delivery outcomes for interfaces, conversions, enhancements, forms, workflows, APIs, OData services, CDS views, batch jobs, and related WRICEF objects.
* Drive cross\-functional integration with SAP EWM, FTM/FI\-CO, OTC/SD, LTO or eCommerce, master data, analytics, security, quality, external suppliers, logistics providers, and financial institutions.
* Ensure robust EDI, IDoc, API, file, and middleware capabilities, including mapping, routing, monitoring, reconciliation, exception handling, reprocessing, and trading\-partner onboarding.
* Balance new capability delivery with technical debt reduction, reliability, performance, compliance, lifecycle management, and production support needs.

 **User Experience, Release \& Value Management**

  

* Champion intuitive, role\-based SAP Fiori experiences across requisitioning, approvals, purchasing, goods receipt, supplier invoicing, exception management, and procurement analytics.
* Use stakeholder feedback, process data, support trends, and user research to identify pain points and prioritize improvements.
* Define release readiness and acceptance expectations across testing, security, data, integration, controls, training, cutover, communications, deployment, and support transition.
